6,060 likes, 56 comments - shankyglobal on September 30, 2026: "Pangong Lake — one of the world’s most breathtaking high-altitude lakes. 🏔️💙

Nestled in the rugged landscapes of Ladakh, Pangong Tso is known for its surreal shades of blue, dramatic Himalayan mountains and vast open skies. The changing light makes the lake look different throughout the day, creating a landscape that feels almost unreal.

From the remote roads of Ladakh to the crystal-clear waters of Pangong, every frame here feels like a postcard from another world.

📍 Pangong Tso, Ladakh, India
